items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The musician Hank Fullalove that you mentioned, you said he wrote Westerns. Did he use his own name? [INTERVIEWEE] No, no, he used a pseudonym.

ctx.x: until. That was until the last soul got out of there, you know. Like, we'd go to work at 9:00, we were idle from 9:00 to 12:00. And then when the other places break up, then that's when we'd have to start work. 12:00 until.
The musician Hank Fullalove that you mentioned, you said he wrote Westerns. Did he use his own name?
No, no, he used a pseudonym.
